description: Share ordinary text files between concurrent agents without silently overwriting edits.
name: io.github.baalimago/slivingdoc

environmentVariables.description: S3-compatible bucket that stores the shared text workspace.
environmentVariables.name: SLIVINGDOC_BUCKET

environmentVariables.description: Optional AWS profile used by the standard AWS credential chain.
environmentVariables.name: AWS_PROFILE

environmentVariables.description: AWS region for the bucket or S3-compatible endpoint.
environmentVariables.name: AWS_REGION

environmentVariables.description: Optional endpoint for an S3-compatible store such as SeaweedFS.
environmentVariables.name: AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3

environmentVariables.description: Optional root that contains directories agents may pull and commit.
environmentVariables.name: SLIVINGDOC_WORKSPACE_ROOT

title: slivingdoc
